title: The Power of Local: Why Saskatchewan Businesses Need a Targeted Digital Marketing Strategy - Directwest, Saskatchewan

facts.fact: The Directwest article 'The Power of Local: Why Saskatchewan Businesses Need a Targeted Digital Marketing Strategy' was published on 2025-07-02.

Directwest defines local digital marketing as reaching real customers in their area where Saskatchewan people spend time, including Google searches, social feeds, streaming platforms, and trusted directories like Mysask411.
facts.quote: It’s about reaching real customers in your area—where Saskatchewan people already spend time: Google searches, social feeds, streaming platforms, and trusted directories like Mysask411.

facts.fact: Directwest says its search marketing ads can appear on Google and YouTube, streaming platforms like Spotify, social media, cinema screens, and digital billboards across Saskatchewan.
facts.quote: we help you appear in the right places:

facts.fact: Directwest states its ads can target by location, interest, and behavior, which it claims results in zero wasted reach.
facts.quote: Our ads are built to target by location, interest, and behavior, so your message reaches the right audience with zero waste.

facts.fact: Directwest describes Mysask411 as a trusted platform where Saskatchewan residents search for businesses, check reviews, read blogs, and stay informed.
facts.quote: It’s a trusted place where Saskatchewan residents search for businesses, check reviews, read blogs, and stay informed.

facts.fact: Directwest states that it has been connecting Saskatchewan businesses with customers for over 100 years.
facts.quote: At Directwest, we’ve been connecting Saskatchewan businesses with customers for over 100 years.

facts.fact: Directwest lists paid ad channels it offers as Search, Social, Display, Cinema, and Spotify.
facts.quote: Paid ads (Search, Social, Display, Cinema, Spotify)

facts.fact: Directwest says its connected solution lets businesses update business info across platforms from one place, post to multiple social channels at once, and track engagement in one dashboard.
facts.quote: Update business info across platforms from one place

facts.fact: Directwest offers a Social media dashboard, Reputation management tools, Mysask411 listings and features, and Google Business Profile setup among its listed services.
Directwest's article states that businesses using original photos see more clicks than those with generic stock images, presented as a 'Real-World Win' without a stated figure.
facts.quote: Businesses that use original photos see more clicks than those with generic stock images.
